cells.gaps: No regulation made under the Act is on record, and one tender of 10 August 2026 seeks consultants to develop regulatory instruments, so none is shown as issued. No decision, sanction or count under the Act is stated; registration and training are the only application. The Data Management Act the minister named on 19 November 2026 (ZMB-022) is a review, with no bill on record.
cells.note: The Data Protection Act No. 3 of 2021 is in force and the Commission is constituted, but application is registration and training only (activity), not a dated decision, so stage 4 is not reached. The 2021 Act is under revision: Cabinet approved a repeal bill in principle in April 2025 (ZMB-014) and the minister said in November 2026 the framework is being reviewed towards a Data Management Act (ZMB-022).
